ui.tz_milestone_guide: Lophatle la nako le phetolo (UTC{tz_str}): Setlelaete se fetola poniso ya nako; go fudusa UTC go kaisa mabenkele mo letsatsing le fetileng kgotsa le latelang.
ui.tz_col_target: Nako le Phetogo ya Letsatsi ya UTC{tz_str}
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Motšine wa Nako: Suthela malatsi morago kgotsa pele mo sekirining go lebelela datha ya nako e e fetileng kgotsa e e tlang/diponelopele, bapisa histori, le go etisa maemo. Go lebelela fela; datha ya motheo ga e amisiwe.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN motheo: e ratang datha ya nnete, e leba phela ya dikgaolo & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter go ralala k, p; mo dikgaoganyong 16 / 116 / 132 kgotsa potologo 1072 e dirisa k*116 + p*16 go ralala k, p go tshwanelana le phela, e tlatisa dikgaoganyong pele fa e le sieo.
ui.tz_rule_mid: E dirisa mokgwa wa 119 ka dinako tsotlhe (k*119 + jitter); fa kgaoganyo e le 16 / 116 / 132 kgotsa e fitlha mo potologong 1072 (mokgwa wa dikgato di le 14), e dirisa k*116 + p*16 go ralala k, p go suthela mo Phase A e e tshwanang (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: E dikologa go ralala mokgwa wa 119 (k*119 + jitter); mo dikgaoganyong 16 / 116 / 132 kgotsa potologo 1072 (k*116 + p*16 go ralala k, p), e rata phela e e siamisiweng ya A2 / C7 mme e boela morago fa datha e seyo.
